name: Indra Oktafian Hidayat
headline: Project Management & Event Operations · Laravel Web Developer
profile: Event operations lead with a nuclear engineering degree who now ships web applications. Ran national-scale programs for 500+ participants and directed 200+ member teams; today builds custom websites and systems on Laravel for freelance clients.

points: Led the team to Overall Champion (Juara Umum) at the 2025 national campus-mosque jamboree by matching each competition to the division best positioned to win it.
Built a weekly content calendar that lifted social media output 90%.
Co-founded Rumah Qur'an: wrote the first curriculum and put a management team behind it.
Ran strategy and operations for a 200+ member organization working across eight departments.
Raised routine-program participation 40% by redesigning engagement around what members actually wanted.
Remapped handoffs across eight departments; the year-end accountability report passed with zero member objections.
Standardized evaluation docs and a feedback loop across 10+ activities, feeding 5+ strategic fixes to a program serving 500+ people.
Ran presenter schedules, room readiness, and session flow for international parallel tracks, keeping moderators and speakers in sync across concurrent rooms.
Set direction for a 500+ participant program and kept 10+ external partners, including government bodies, on board through written agreements.
Owned the full lifecycle of daily and weekly programming for 500+ people under strict budget controls.
Split work cleanly across creative, operations, and PR, leading a 200+ member team under tight deadlines.
Planned and delivered the faculty orientation end-to-end: schedule, committee, participants, and event operations. Onboarded 80 new students.

awards: Overall Champion (Juara Umum), National Jamboree of the Indonesian Campus Mosque Association — 2025
2nd Place, Mosque Program Innovation Competition, National Jamboree of the Indonesian Campus Mosque Association — 2023
